subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 7: Skills – Reading (a story: Wadi rescue!)
outcomes: Understand the main events of the story Wadi rescue!
Find action verbs and story details.
Explain what an emergency signal is and why it helps.

tf.why: Correct! He visits him in Sur.

tf.s: The canoe turns over because of a big tree across the wadi.
tf.why: Well done! The tree is in the way.
Yes! They go canoeing in the wadi.

tf.s: Jasim blows the whistle quietly five times.
tf.why: He blows it loudly six times.

tf.s: Six whistles is the emergency signal.
tf.why: Great! People hear it and come to help.

tf.s: A car takes Amjed to hospital.
tf.why: A helicopter takes Amjed to hospital.

mcq.q: Why does the canoe turn over?
o: Because of a big tree across the wadi.

o: a sign to call for help

mcq.why: A lake is calmer, so it's easier.

o: Jasim blows the whistle loudly six times.
